# ferentin_mcp_provider (Resource)

A tenant-custom MCP provider definition. Use to publish your own MCP server into the tenant catalog (vs `data "ferentin_mcp_provider"` which reads the global catalog). v0.1 exposes flat fields; nested auth/scopes/setup configs are v0.2.

## Import

Existing providers can be imported using `<tenant_id>/<provider_id>` (or `<provider_id>` alone when the provider's default `tenant_id` matches):

```
terraform import ferentin_mcp_provider.example <tenant_id>/<provider_id>
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Tenant-custom MCP provider — defines an MCP server entry in the tenant's
# private catalog. The global catalog is read-only; this is for "your own
# upstream we want to expose".
resource "ferentin_mcp_provider" "internal_search" {
  display_name = "Internal Document Search"
  description  = "Tenant-private MCP provider for internal search."
  slug         = "internal-search"
  icon         = "search"
  owner        = "platform-team"
  contact      = "platform@example.com"
  default_url  = "https://search.internal.example.com/mcp/sse"
  transport    = "sse"
  category     = "search"

  enabled_scopes = [
    "search:read",
    "search:cite",
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String)

### Optional

- `allow_endpoint_override` (Boolean) When true, downstream `mcp_server` instances may override the catalog endpoint URL. Default `false`.
- `category` (String)
- `contact` (String)
- `default_url` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled_scopes` (List of String)
- `icon` (String)
- `owner` (String)
- `slug` (String) URL slug; if unset, derived from display_name.
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `transport` (String) Transport. Allowed: `stdio`, `sse`, `http`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_modified_by` (String)
- `managed_by` (String)
- `managed_by_client_id` (String)
- `managed_by_module` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `provider_id` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
